reason: Product Experience Shell P0 intentionally replaces the retired flat YanceWorkspace implementation with a thin Element composition root. Existing WP0 contracts for Element, Letta, Parlant, Media and Presence still bind preserved semantic requirements to implementation tokens inside YanceWorkspace.tsx. Stage #1857 on Product exact Head ebde6ea965adf5f796c04512ba072bb9812c30af and Stage #1858 on semantic-repair Head 920e4db40a0cc2ae6988cb8cb9293d77b4f0984c prove that these source-location assertions remain RED even though Product architecture, interaction and accessibility contracts are green and the new Product authority preserves Letta refresh and unsaved Goal-draft semantics without restoring the flat dashboard. Because the migration implementation must merge to trusted main before Product source files exist there, this authorization requires permanent dual-layout semantic contracts: the same tests must preserve current-main assertions when ProductExperienceShell is absent and must automatically switch to the new Product authority when ProductExperienceShell exists. Layout selection may depend only on repository file existence, never branch name, environment, CI state or skip flags, and both layouts must assert equivalent authority and behavior.

transitionCompatibility.newLayoutContract: When ProductExperienceShell.tsx is present, each migrated test must assert the corresponding Product Experience source authority and must not fall back to YanceWorkspace implementation-token assertions.

presence: Presence remains visibly reachable through the existing top-level capability in current main and through the Product relationship Action Dock plus RelationshipOverlayHost in the Product layout.
PresenceWorkspace and official livekit-client remain the realtime authority in either layout; no custom WebRTC transport is created.
